qa_dispositions.result: Back with an unaccepted candidate now presents Save and go, Go without saving, and Stay. Save failures retain the candidate; the mock discard mutation requires the current live grant for this tab actor and fingerprints the actor. The service test verifies another same-account/session actor is denied without losing the candidate, owner discard succeeds, and replay of the owner operation ID conflicts. Browser save/discard preserves the accepted-take count.

The phone stage now fits against the later of the full dialogue header and waveform timeline, leaving at least 8px before the pinned panel at 390px, 767px, and long Russian copy. When a readable 320px stage cannot fit, controls move into document flow; the short-height fallback remains scrollable.
Recording Play/Pause and segmented modes consume the shared medium classes. Desktop measurements are 40px, 14px/20px; phone controls are 48px, 16px/24px.
